# yesmcp

> yesmcp designs, ships and runs Model Context Protocol connectors for businesses,
> so a company's own customers can book, order, check status and get support right
> inside an AI chat (Claude, ChatGPT). Custom servers over existing APIs and legacy
> systems, OAuth 2.1 and authorisation review, readiness for the 2026-07-28
> specification, and interactive UI (MCP Apps) inside the assistant.

The evidence offered is our own connector, which runs in production in claude.ai,
and a weekly hand-counted census of the Claude connector directory published as an
open dataset. Every number published here was measured on a real system and is
dated. Built and run by Serhii Kravchenko (AI engineer); articles are written in
the first person and signed. Founding clients get founding terms and a
co-published case study.

## Pages

- [Home](https://yesmcp.com/): what a connector is, how the three-step build works,
  what has been shipped and tested, and the scenarios a business can put into a chat.
- [Writing](https://yesmcp.com/writing/): first-person notes from a production MCP
  server, plus the weekly directory census.
- [About](https://yesmcp.com/about/): who is behind yesmcp — AI engineer Serhii
  Kravchenko, running the routine on a team of AI agents he built. What has been
  built and verified (a production MCP server with OAuth 2.1 serving a live user
  through Claude on web, mobile and desktop; MCP Apps views rendering with real
  data), and how these notes are produced.
- [Privacy](https://yesmcp.com/privacy/): the site collects nothing; what the
  connector collects and logs is described there in full.
- [Connect](https://yesmcp.com/connect/): add the yesmcp connector to your own
  Claude in under a minute (one URL, no login) and book a real consultation
  from inside the chat.
- [Book a call](https://yesmcp.com/book/): pick a day in the calendar, pick a
  half-hour in your own timezone and book a free 30-minute call. No account and
  no AI chat needed; the same availability the connector's `list_availability`
  tool serves inside Claude.
- [Scenario map](https://yesmcp.com/scenario-map/): pick one of eight business
  types (clinics, online shops, local services, private education, professional
  services and agencies, restaurants, SaaS support, salons), answer two
  questions, and get the concrete scenarios
  your customers and your team could run inside an AI chat, with a feasibility
  verdict on your current systems. The same diagnostic the connector's
  `advise_scenarios` tool runs inside Claude, mirrored here with no install.

- [For professional services and agencies](https://yesmcp.com/for/professional-services/):
  the vertical page for law firms, accounting practices, consultancies and agencies.
  What a firm's own clients can do inside their AI chat (project status, booking the
  right person, billing questions, blockers, what a service covers), what the team gets
  behind a login, the five risk questions answered one by one (scope, writes,
  prompt injection through client files, audit log, contract exposure), what the firm
  has to provide, and how cost and time work: the diagnosis is free, the first scenario
  is a fixed price quoted per firm, running it is a monthly line, a wrong first scenario
  is replaced from the map at no extra cost, and a first scenario against a system with
  an API takes about two weeks. No prices are published: every engagement is quoted
  individually at the free diagnosis.

## Ukrainian version (українською)

- [Головна](https://yesmcp.com/ua/): що таке MCP-конектор, як працює побудова у
  три кроки і які сценарії бізнес може дати клієнтам у чаті.
- [Про нас](https://yesmcp.com/ua/about/): хто за yesmcp — AI-інженер Сергій Кравченко, рутину веде команда AI-агентів.
- [Нотатки](https://yesmcp.com/ua/writing/): український архів нотаток; перша стаття: [Конектори Claude для бізнесу](https://yesmcp.com/ua/writing/claude-connectors-for-business/) зі щотижневим переписом каталогу конекторів.
- [Приватність](https://yesmcp.com/ua/privacy/): сайт не збирає нічого; що збирає
  і журналює конектор, описано там повністю.
- [Підключення](https://yesmcp.com/ua/connect/): додайте конектор yesmcp у свій
  Claude за хвилину (одне посилання, без логіна) і забронюйте консультацію
  просто в чаті.
- [Запис на розмову](https://yesmcp.com/ua/book/): оберіть день у календарі,
  оберіть півгодини у своїй часовій зоні і запишіться на безкоштовну 30-хвилинну
  розмову. Без акаунта і без ШІ-чату; той самий вільний час, який конектор віддає
  інструментом `list_availability` у Claude.
- [Мапа сценаріїв](https://yesmcp.com/ua/scenario-map/): оберіть один із восьми
  типів бізнесу (клініки, інтернет-магазини, локальні послуги, приватна освіта,
  професійні послуги та агенції, ресторани, підтримка SaaS, салони), дайте
  відповідь на два запитання і
  отримайте конкретні сценарії для ваших клієнтів і вашої команди у ШІ-чаті
  разом з оцінкою готовності ваших систем.

- [Для професійних послуг та агенцій](https://yesmcp.com/ua/for/professional-services/):
  сторінка вертикалі для юридичних фірм, бухгалтерських практик, консалтингу та агенцій.
  Що клієнти фірми роблять у власному ШІ-чаті, що бачить команда за логіном, п'ять
  питань про ризик з відповідями, що потрібно з боку фірми, і як влаштовані ціна й час:
  діагностика безкоштовна, перший сценарій це фіксована ціна, порахована для конкретної
  фірми, робота конектора це місячний рядок, не той сценарій міняється на наступний з
  мапи без доплати, а перший сценарій проти системи з API займає приблизно два тижні.
  Цін на сайті немає: кожен проєкт рахується окремо на безкоштовній діагностиці.

## Writing

- [Claude connectors for business](https://yesmcp.com/writing/claude-connectors-for-business/): the owner-side guide to the claude.ai connector directory, with a first-party weekly census (per-category counts and week-over-week change), the client install path, the custom-connector pattern, and the ChatGPT directory path. Ukrainian version: https://yesmcp.com/ua/writing/claude-connectors-for-business/
- [The MCP spec shipped one day after its SDK](https://yesmcp.com/writing/spec-shipped-after-its-sdk/): the 2026-07-28 stateless rewrite started a twelve-month migration clock; the TypeScript SDK was published 2026-07-27 and supports protocol versions only up to 2025-11-25, so the migration cannot be executed yet.
- [Your tool results are being read as an attack](https://yesmcp.com/writing/tool-results-read-as-injection/): imperative instructions inside a tool result match the tool-poisoning signature; a host warned a real user about our own connector. How we split the channels, and what it saved (frame 1043 → 509 characters, ~130 tokens per call).
- [What the host doesn't deliver](https://yesmcp.com/writing/what-the-host-does-not-deliver/): the server `instructions` field never reaches the model; a deferred tool's description is unreachable until the tool loads; a new MCP session opens on nearly every call; the tool list is re-sent before every call (5698 bytes).

## Connector

- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.yesmcp.com/mcp
- Ten tools. Read-only: `list_availability` (open consultation windows),
  `get_services` (what yesmcp builds and how an engagement runs),
  `advise_scenarios` (two questions → a scenario map for a business type),
  `demo_walkthrough` (a guided tour of the connector), `directory_census`
  (live counts from our weekly hand census of the Claude connector directory),
  and the two that draw interactive cards in the chat, `booking_widget` and
  `services_widget`. Booking management: `book_consult`, `cancel_booking`,
  `reschedule_booking`.
- What is stored: a booking stores three fields you give at that moment — name,
  email, topic (a booking made inside Telegram adds the Telegram id and username,
  handed over by Telegram itself). Tool calls are logged for reliability and
  abuse investigation; for a booking, that log line contains the same three
  fields and nothing more. Records are kept 24 months. Full text:
  https://yesmcp.com/privacy/

## Open data

- Directory census dataset (Claude connector directory: totals and per-category
  counts, snapshot history, CC BY 4.0): https://yesmcp.com/data/directory.json
